final: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS o FROM Products), t AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS a FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), k1 AS (SELECT t.* FROM t, overall WHERE overall.o IS NOT NULL AND t.a > overall.o), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mm FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.* FROM k1, m WHERE k1.a > m.mm) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS avg_type_price, AVG(k2.a - overall.o) AS above_overall, AVG(k2.a - m.mm) AS above_kept_mean FROM k2, overall, m
